adjudication.rationale: The client-side action `addMembers` explicitly notes `// TODO: should clear the input` and does not reset `this.get("usernames")` after calling `this.get("model").addMembers(...)`, so repeated clicks can resend the same usernames (admin-group.js.es6). However, the claim that this will create duplicate `GroupUser` rows is not verifiable from the diff: `Admin::GroupsController#add_members` loops `group.add(user)` without an explicit dedup check, but whether duplicates can be created depends on model/DB constraints and `group.add` implementation not shown here.
